canonical.title: A Weekend in La Rochelle, Anchored on a Michelin Dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in La Rochelle
siblings.summary: A weekend in La Rochelle built around a Michelin dinner: the three towers, Europe-class aquarium, Île de Ré, beaches, oysters, and how to get around.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in La Rochelle
siblings.summary: La Rochelle has exactly one restaurant rated 2 stars or above: Christopher Coutanceau, a 3-star temple of sustainable seafood.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in La Rochelle
siblings.summary: La Rochelle hosts two recurring anchor events — the IA-NA AI congress (June) and the EBG Digital Benchmark (October).

sources.title: Michelin Guide — La Rochelle restaurants
sources.claim: La Rochelle has exactly one restaurant at 2-star level or above in all of Charente-Maritime

sources.title: Restaurant Coutanceau — official
sources.claim: Menus from €275 (7-course) to €340 (9-course); wine pairings +€90–130

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Christopher Coutanceau
sources.claim: Weekend slots go weeks to months in advance

sources.title: Christopher Coutanceau — official site
sources.claim: Green Star for ecological commitment — no threatened species, all fish parts used

sources.title: Île de Ré — cycling guide
sources.claim: 138 km of cycle paths across a toll-free bridge

sources.title: Aquarium La Rochelle — tickets
sources.claim: Timed-entry ticket needed; walk-in capacity not guaranteed. Adult €18.50.

sources.title: Towers of La Rochelle — official
sources.claim: Tour Saint-Nicolas closed 2026 for maintenance; other two open

sources.title: La Yole de Chris — official
sources.claim: Coutanceau's casual address; oysters from €3.50, platters €42–100, open daily 9am–11pm

sources.title: Towers of La Rochelle — practical info
sources.claim: Single ticket €9.50; combined €15 with one museum; EU residents under 26 free

sources.title: Aquarium de La Rochelle — homepage
sources.claim: One of Europe's largest private aquariums; ~12,000 animals

sources.title: Bar André — official
sources.claim: Seafood brasserie going since 1947, MOF chef Johan Leclerre, open daily 9am–11pm

sources.title: Yélo bikes — official
sources.claim: 760 yellow bikes across 117 stations; €1 first 30 min, €1.50/extra half-hour

sources.title: Compagnie Inter-îles — official
sources.claim: Fort Boyard cruise from Vieux-Port; sea promenade from €23.50, commented tour ~€29

sources.title: Île de Ré bridge — tolls
sources.claim: Car toll €8 medium season (2 Mar–14 Jun), free for bikes

sources.title: Île de Ré — official tourism site
sources.claim: Île de Ré: 138 km cycle paths, UNESCO village Saint-Martin, Phare des Baleines

sources.title: La Rochelle June weather
sources.claim: Early June: ~21°C, 9.6h sun/day, ~15h42m daylight, sea ~16.7°C

sources.title: Musée Maritime La Rochelle
sources.claim: Board the France 1 weather frigate and Angoumois trawler; free under 18

sources.title: Le Bunker de La Rochelle
sources.claim: Secret 1941 U-boat command bunker; €7 adult, ~45 min visit

sources.title: Marché Central La Rochelle
sources.claim: 19th-century covered hall, open daily 8:00–13:30; fish, oysters, cheese, foie gras

sources.title: Trainline — Paris to La Rochelle
sources.claim: Direct TGV/OUIGO from Paris, ~17×/day, fastest ~2h41m
